output.code:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

file_path = "/mnt/data/assistant-566Ey1FJA5cD7JAAWt9fBM-synthetic_500_quarterly_results.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter TRANSPORTATION sector
transport_df = df[df['sector'].str.upper() == 'TRANSPORTATION']

# Create bar chart for operating profit
plt.figure(figsize=(12,6))
plt.bar(transport_df['company'], transport_df['operating_profit'])
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.xlabel("Company")
plt.ylabel("Operating Profit")
plt.title("Operating Profit - TRANSPORTATION Sector")
plt.tight_layout()

output_path = "/mnt/data/transportation_operating_profit_bar_chart.png"
plt.savefig(output_path)
output_path

import numpy as np

# Clean numeric columns (remove commas, convert to float)
def to_float(s):
    return pd.to_numeric(s.astype(str).str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')

transport_df = df[df['sector'].str.upper() == 'TRANSPORTATION'].copy()
transport_df['operating_profit_num'] = to_float(transport_df['operating_profit'])

# Sort for nicer plot
transport_df = transport_df.sort_values('operating_profit_num', ascending=False)

plt.figure(figsize=(14,6))
plt.bar(transport_df['name'], transport_df['operating_profit_num'], color="#2E86AB")
plt.xticks(rotation=75, ha='right')
plt.xlabel("Company")
plt.ylabel("Operating Profit")
plt.title("Operating Profit - TRANSPORTATION Sector")
plt.tight_layout()

output_path = "/mnt/data/transportation_operating_profit_bar_chart.png"
plt.savefig(output_path, dpi=200)
output_path
